optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Procurement Operations Specialist, Insurance Claims Platform
professionalSummary: Experienced in preparing tender files, compiling performance packs, collating supplier proposals, and documenting end‑of‑cycle notes for a regional repair and inspection panel.
Demonstrated ability to manage supplier performance data and produce actionable review packs for senior procurement leadership.
experienceHighlights: Prepared the tender file for the regional repair and inspection panel, including supplier questionnaires, scoring template, and comparison sheet used in award meetings.
Compiled quarterly supplier performance packs from claims cycle‑time and complaint data and presented them at review meetings.
Collated supplier proposals, checked them against the rate card, and drafted award letters for signature.
Wrote end‑of‑cycle notes after each tender, listing probationary suppliers, open contract clauses, and hand‑over items for the contract administrator.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Scoring template and comparison sheet from the last repair‑panel tender and one quarterly performance pack, with procurement system document identifiers as verification trail.
